summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares preinstall: `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime and uses execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` — a single-line ~727 KB JavaScript file with `_0x`-style shuffled string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator, hex-named globals, encoded literal table). The declared `main` (`jest-preset.js`) contains only `throw new Error('Use @ornikar/jest-config-react-native/web instead');`, so the package delivers no Jest-preset functionality — its only executed code path on `npm install` is the preinstall hook that fetches an alternate JavaScript runtime and executes an opaque obfuscated blob under it. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun binary rather than the ambient Node runtime evades Node-oriented instrumentation. The combination of preinstall lifecycle execution, alternate-runtime dispatch, heavy obfuscation of the executed bytes, and a hollow advertised surface matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
